newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-GANZ MAKES SURE MAMMA SEES HIS GOALS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GANZ MAKES SURE MAMMA SEES HIS GOALS.

text.p: Italian men have long been known for their close ties to their mothers and Internazionale striker Maurizio Ganz is no exception.
Ganz became Inter's man of the moment with a sparkling two-goal performance in the 3-1 UEFA Cup semifinal first leg win over Monaco on Tuesday.
He gave an interview to Italia 1 television in which he dedicated his goals to his mother who had been unable to watch the game at the San Siro.
But Ganz was dismayed when he heard that the broadcast was planned for the early hours of the morning, long after his mother would have gone to bed.
His plea for a programming change was accepted so his number one fan could tune in before she retired for the night.
